crossRefs.note: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
crossRefs.keyword: the speech of the trusty. Heb. the lip of the faithful

crossRefs.note: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
crossRefs.keyword: the speech of the trusty. Heb. the lip of the faithful

crossRefs.note: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
crossRefs.keyword: the speech of the trusty. Heb. the lip of the faithful

crossRefs.note: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where…
For you have hidden their heart from understanding, Therefore you will not exalt them.
It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.
For, behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply…

translations.web: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
translations.bsb: He deprives the trusted of speech and takes away the discernment of elders.
translations.kjv: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.
translations.asv: He removeth the speech of the trusty, And taketh away the understanding of the elders.
